focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业需紧急核查数据申报合规性
focus.summary: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征税阶段。近期欧盟委员会加强了对进口商季度报告的审查，未完整申报隐含碳排放的货物可能面临每吨未申报排放10至50欧元的罚款。中国钢铁、铝、化肥、氢等行业出口商应尽快梳理供应链碳排放数据，确保境外进口商合规申报，避免货物滞留或罚款转嫁。建议企业提前建立产品碳足迹核算体系，并关注欧盟认可的核查机构名单。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会气候行动总司 · 2026.10.01
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Urged to Verify Emissions Data Reporting Compliance
focus.summary_en: The EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period ends in late 2026, with the definitive regime starting in 2027. The European Commission has recently intensified scrutiny of importers' quarterly reports, and goods with incomplete embedded emissions declarations may face penalties of EUR 10–50 per tonne of unreported emissions. Chinese exporters in steel, aluminium, fertilisers, and hydrogen should map supply chain carbon data to ensure importers comply and avoid cargo delays or penalty pass-through. Companies are advised to establish product carbon footprint systems and monitor EU-accredited verifier lists.

case.title: 香港仲裁裁决在内地执行获支持：某中资企业凭临时措施成功冻结被申请人资产
case.summary: 近期，内地某中级人民法院依据《关于内地与香港特别行政区相互执行仲裁裁决的安排》及补充安排，认可并执行了一份香港国际仲裁中心（HKIAC）的仲裁裁决。该案中，中资企业申请人在仲裁程序启动后即向香港仲裁庭申请临时保全措施，并依据内地与香港的保全协助机制向内地法院申请冻结被申请人在内地的银行账户，最终裁决得以顺利执行。本案提示跨境交易方：在争议初期即应善用两地保全协助机制，防止对方转移资产，提高裁决可执行性。
case.source: 来源：香港国际仲裁中心（HKIAC）案例评析 · 2026年第三季度
case.title_en: HK Arbitral Award Enforced in Mainland: Chinese Company Freezes Respondent's Assets via Interim Measures
case.summary_en: A mainland Intermediate People's Court recently recognised and enforced an HKIAC arbitral award under the Mainland-Hong Kong Arrangement on Mutual Enforcement of Arbitral Awards and its Supplementary Arrangement. The Chinese claimant had obtained interim preservation measures from the Hong Kong tribunal and, through the cross-border preservation assistance mechanism, applied to a mainland court to freeze the respondent's bank accounts there, facilitating final enforcement. The case highlights that parties to cross-border transactions should utilise the bilateral preservation mechanism early to prevent asset dissipation and enhance award enforceability.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区推出跨境商事纠纷“一站式”在线解纷平台，支持港澳调解与仲裁对接
policy.summary: 广东省司法厅与香港律政司、澳门法务局近期联合推出粤港澳大湾区跨境商事纠纷“一站式”在线解纷平台。该平台整合三地调解、仲裁资源，允许企业在线提交争议、选择港澳调解员或仲裁员，并支持电子送达与在线听证。平台还对接了内地法院的司法确认程序，经港澳调解组织达成的和解协议可快速获得内地法院确认执行力。此举旨在降低跨境解纷成本，提升大湾区法治化营商环境，尤其利好中小外贸企业。
policy.source: 来源：广东省司法厅、香港律政司联合公告 · 2026年9月
policy.title_en: GBA Launches One-Stop Online Dispute Resolution Platform Linking HK/Macao Mediation and Arbitration
policy.summary_en: The Guangdong Department of Justice, Hong Kong Department of Justice, and Macao Legal Affairs Bureau have jointly launched a one-stop online dispute resolution platform for cross-border commercial disputes in the Greater Bay Area. The platform integrates mediation and arbitration resources across the three jurisdictions, allowing businesses to file disputes online, select Hong Kong or Macao mediators/arbitrators, and conduct e-service and online hearings. It also connects with mainland judicial confirmation procedures, enabling settlement agreements reached through HK/Macao mediation organisations to obtain prompt enforceability in mainland courts, reducing costs and improving the business environment, especially for SMEs.
policy.source_en: Source: Joint Announcement of Guangdong Department of Justice and Hong Kong Department of Justice · September 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规扩围，中国科技企业需重构跨境股权与数据架构
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部近期拟进一步扩大对外投资安全审查范围，将更多涉及人工智能、量子计算和先进半导体的中国实体纳入限制清单。中国科技企业应尽快排查自身是否落入“受关注外国人士”定义，审慎设计跨境股权架构与数据流动路径，避免因美资股东或美元基金参与而触发申报义务。建议企业：一、对现有美元融资协议中的“控制权变更”和“合规陈述”条款进行压力测试；二、提前准备替代性融资方案；三、在跨境数据传输中采用本地化与加密措施，降低次级制裁风险。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师团队内部研判 · 2026.10.01
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Expanded US Outbound Investment Screening Requires Chinese Tech Firms to Rethink Cross-Border Equity and Data Structures
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Treasury is poised to further expand outbound investment security screening, adding more Chinese entities in AI, quantum computing, and advanced semiconductors to restricted lists. Chinese tech companies should promptly assess whether they fall within the definition of a 'foreign person of concern' and carefully design cross-border equity and data flows to avoid triggering filing obligations due to US investors or dollar funds. Recommendations: (1) stress-test 'change of control' and 'compliance representations' clauses in existing dollar financing agreements; (2) prepare alternative financing plans; (3) adopt localisation and encryption in cross-border data transfers to mitigate secondary sanctions risks.
analysis.source_en: Source: Internal Analysis by Attorney Qin Linhao's Team · 2026.10.01
